meta.basis: 100 synthetic persona/workflow validation cases derived from public internet research on inspection repair negotiations, Texas option-period workflow, Colorado inspection objection/resolution workflow, Florida AS IS inspection-period leverage, FHA/HUD and VA property standards, Fannie Mae seller-credit limits, condo/HOA responsibility boundaries, inspection report repair-request tooling, and inspector ethics boundaries.
meta.warning: These cases are synthetic research translations for product validation only. They are not customer interviews, legal advice, lending advice, or state-specific brokerage instructions.

cases.sourceBasis: Repair-negotiation guidance: major safety, system, habitability, and structural defects deserve more focus than cosmetic or upgrade items.
cases.persona: Buyer agent triaging a long report for a move-up buyer
cases.deal: Conventional purchase with five inspection-contingency days remaining and seller already frustrated by earlier price renegotiation.
findings: main panel has scorched bus bar
roof boot flashing leaking into attic
cases.requiredGate: agent must separate critical ask from maintenance list before drafting
cases.riskIfWrong: The seller receives a cluttered punch list and ignores the defects that most affect safety and closing.

cases.sourceBasis: Repair-negotiation guidance: known age and buyer preferences should not be reframed as inspection defects without evidence of failure.
cases.persona: Buyer agent representing clients who want a discount after seeing an old kitchen
cases.deal: House was priced below updated comparables and buyers toured twice before inspection.
findings: range is older but all burners operate
cases.riskIfWrong: The product validates a cosmetic price grab and weakens an otherwise reasonable plumbing request.

cases.sourceBasis: Repair-negotiation guidance: old-but-working systems require verification or quotes before replacement-level demands.
cases.persona: Buyer agent handling an HVAC age dispute
cases.deal: Conventional buyer wants a full HVAC replacement credit because the condenser is near expected service-life limits.
findings: condenser is old but cooled at inspection
cases.riskIfWrong: A replacement request unsupported by failure evidence gets rejected and makes the agent look unserious.

cases.sourceBasis: Repair-negotiation guidance: active water intrusion usually outranks cosmetic surfaces and minor wear.
cases.persona: Buyer agent preparing a concise seller credit request
cases.deal: Coastal property inspection found multiple moisture clues but the buyer is fixated on faded finishes.
cases.riskIfWrong: The ask repairs visible damage without addressing the leak path that could continue after closing.

cases.sourceBasis: Repair-negotiation guidance: structural movement should be escalated to specialist review rather than buried among minor finish defects.
cases.persona: Buyer agent with a cautious but nontechnical buyer

findings: horizontal basement wall crack with displacement

cases.sourceBasis: Repair-negotiation guidance: electrical safety items carry more negotiation weight than minor convenience issues.

cases.deal: Seller has signaled willingness to consider a short, safety-only amendment.

cases.sourceBasis: Repair-negotiation guidance: pest, moisture, and structural risks need documentation and often specialist quotes.

findings: active termite tubes at sill plate

findings: loose stair rail at second-floor landing

unit water heater is rusting at base

bath fan as lead negotiation point

upstairs unit plumbing is suspected source
